purpose: Project grove nexus variants and quarry Mine Tunnels from their matching surface regions. Apply path themes to all paths on cave levels 1 and 2; medium/large roads and buildings remain cave walls; sm_road receives underground street variants.

scope.pathCoverage: All eligible path geometry on levels 1 and 2, independent of park/nexus proximity; including sm_road streets; never medium/large roads or levels 3+.
scope.buildingAndRoadTerrain: Houses, temples, md_road and lg_road footprints remain CAVE_WALL. Explicit exception: carve eligible sm_road footprints for underground streets on depths 1 and 2; building, protected water and access exclusions still win.
scope.standaloneShrines: Retain the explicitly designed Ember altar and Toad idol as freestanding cave interactables, not temple buildings or mirrored houses. Every existing path theme and sm_road street variant also has a 50% shrine roll per canonical route and depth, using existing shrine boons and daily ledgers.

source.regions: Stable generated surface nexus anchors and their original coverage; select by nexus kind rather than any nearby park, seep or rock terrain.
exclude: parking aisles pruned by current pipeline
md_road and lg_road; sm_road is explicitly eligible
water crossings and bridge spans without an explicit underground connector
source.pathSelection: Use the existing path-class predicate plus explicit sm_road terrain eligibility. Context selects a theme, not whether an eligible route receives one.
source.nexusMappingPolicy: The four grove variants apply only beneath grove nexuses. Quarry regions always use Mine Tunnels; seep regions receive none of these nexus variants.

identity.inputs: generated surface metadata at every depth; independent of player position, tile clipping, restoration and dug walls

terrainContract: Apply a path theme to every eligible path on cave levels 1 and 2 before generic cave dressing. Use existing cave-floor path geometry; eligible sm_road streets are explicitly selected and carved for these variants. Parks and nexus proximity influence theme choice only.
No carve through building or water provenance, md_road and lg_road bands (sm_road is the explicit shallow-depth carve exception), saved structures, or excluded access regions.
Keep a per-depth geology base separate from the projected design overlay, so a shallow corridor does not silently propagate deeper.
Plan original staircase identities from the existing unmodified geology. Preserve actual stairs and reserve clear approaches before adding zone pieces.
Connect a park chamber only to a route that intersects or reaches it through eligible park floor; no straight-line connection across unrelated obstructions.
Do not close existing reachable routes to force a warren maze. Use wall-adjacent rooms and removable obstacles outside the through lane.
At seams use canonical source geometry and world positions; ambiguous or missing geometry keeps ordinary cave generation.

Seep Passage intentionally replaces eligible underground route floor with WATER. Preserve dry bank connectivity and crossings before decorating; do not paint surface roads or inherited protected water/building provenance.
Only grove surface anchors may select spring cave, goblin warrens, mushroom cavern or gemstone cavern. Seep anchors do not select these variants; quarry anchors select Mine Tunnels.

Underground nexus areas have no temple buildings. Houses and md_road/lg_road remain CAVE_WALL, including inside nexus coverage; eligible sm_road streets are carved on depths 1 and 2. Standalone Ember and Toad shrines remain small cave interactables.
economy: Anchor regions from surface geography, even when POI mirrors are pruned at an earlier depth.
Style at most one surviving mirror as the cache; retain its current chest-tier and depth rules in the first slice.
If no mirror survives, keep a spring or encounter landmark without minting a replacement chest.

Zone finds and containers replace ordinary cave resource seats. The newly requested dense goblin and mushroom encounters use explicit finite zone budgets; measure their additional combat loot before activation.
Path intersections confer connectivity, not extra rewards or extra daily ledgers.
Use existing picked/opened/caught/treasure persistence with stable depth-qualified IDs.
One shrine per qualifying nexus region and depth, using the existing daily shrine ledger and boon rules. The boon replaces its shrine treasure gift; tile fragments never duplicate it.

Miners’ Way explicitly adds sparse bonus ore from the floor level tier. Depth 1 uses its existing copper exception; depth 2+ selects that floor tier, capped at the mineral maximum. Bonus totals need tuning before runtime activation.

Reuse quarry rock and depth-eligible gem appearances without importing surface quarry first-rock guarantees, buried finds or extra site rewards. Underground placements retain their declared rock/deposit rules and depth-qualified budgets.
Mine Tunnels is a simple finite ore-rich deposit per quarry anchor and depth. It creates no extra cache, shrine, temple or imported surface quarry first-rock guarantee.

Dedicated gemstone art is present for all seven catalogued gems; only depth-eligible gems appear in each preview. Deposits must pay their pictured gem; runtime nexus placement uses the shared deposit and item catalog.
Ordinary D2 low-tier gems replace existing non-suppressed rock seats; proposed bonus areas increase selection chance, not rock density or reset frequency.
All walking-path and sm_road variants roll a shrine at 50% once per canonical route/depth, using existing boon and daily ledger rules.
Gemstone cavern/mine and path, including Miners’ Way pockets, never render or yield gems above the current depth tier.

implementation.deliverable: Preview source-kind mapping: grove anchors to the four grove variants, quarry anchors to Mine Tunnels, and no nexus mapping from seep. Independently theme all path geometry on cave levels 1 and 2.

Add nexus and path masks with separate depth scopes. Path themes cover every eligible path only on levels 1 and 2; include eligible sm_road streets; exclude md_road and lg_road. Preserve staircase topology and inherited geology.
Place mapped grove layouts and quarry ore deposits before generic rocks, mushrooms and enemies; preserve routes and keep house and md_road/lg_road walls intact.
Override local EnemyHabitats.caveAt context with zone context, intersect enemy roster depth rules and reallocate existing encounter budget.
Register only selected art frames, interactions and footprints; audit economy, reachability, persistence and frame-time cost.

Implement depth-filtered gems and non-suppressed D2 rock replacements; sm_road scatter and 50% route shrines; separate inert vents, stakes-equivalent stalagmites, story-driven fall holes and proximity-revealed snare-equivalent pits. These draft fields are not runtime registration.

checks: Same source region and route across adjacent tiles and reversed load order.
Reload, player digging and surface restoration never reroll generated anchors.
Every active nexus and stair has a walkable approach; all required through routes remain connected.
No carves under excluded roads, buildings or water; no surface terrain change.
No duplicate finds, guards or caches at seams and junctions.
Depth 1 never uses deeper goblin roster entries; no empty habitat silently produces illegal enemies.
Compare capped chest totals and expected resource value against baseline cave seeds.
Check inspected art at game scale, transparent margins, frame rectangles, readable interactions and shared footprint reservation.
Every eligible path receives one theme on cave levels 1 and 2, including paths outside parks and away from nexus regions.
Underground path/street variants apply to walking paths and sm_road only on depths 1 and 2; exclude md_road, lg_road and depths 3+.
Only grove anchors select the four grove nexus variants; quarry anchors select Mine Tunnels and seep anchors select none of them.
No temple or house interiors appear underground; house and md_road/lg_road cells remain cave walls after nexus placement; eligible sm_road cells form streets.
Neither nexus variants nor path themes apply at cave levels 3 or deeper.
Dense goblin and mushroom counts are owned once per source region/depth; route goblin patrols and seep cubes do not multiply at seams.
Spring skeletons remain invisible and inactive beyond one cell, reveal at the one-cell boundary, remain revealed after retreat, and do not reappear after defeat/reload.
Named-zone skeleton, mushroom and cube exceptions do not change ambient cave enemy eligibility.
D1 gem previews and drops are quartz only; D2 uses only quartz/topaz, including Miners’ Way.
D2 ordinary gems never bypass suppression; beaches, commercial landcover and sm_road use the declared bonus without stacking.
Inactive vents emit no gas; stalagmites match charred-stakes mechanics. Combined vent/stalagmite/hole street coverage targets 10%, keeping safe routes.
Entering a hole shows exactly one falling panel, applies 25% maximum energy once, and safely descends exactly one floor, including D2 to D3. No valid deeper floor means no hole.
Hidden pits have no sprite before adjacency/entry; discovery persists and damage matches surface snares.
All existing paths and sm_road variants use one 50% shrine roll per canonical route/depth; no duplicate shrine at seams or junctions.
High-tier palette motif slots resolve to depth-eligible gems before rendering; no preview exposes locked gem tiers.

encounters.countPolicy: One elite strongest depth-eligible defender per route; ordinary Bat art represents the level-1 guard here.

previewRows.artNote: Accepted bone-pile art is shipped as bone_cache; runtime clusters and one-time rewards are implemented.

previewNote: Design-only layouts. Registered game art supplies rocks, gems, walls, shrines, stalagmites, holes and pit traps. Compact inactive poison vent is a new proposal asset; spring source remains an archived candidate. Minecart uses labeled handcart placeholder. Hidden pits are shown revealed only in annotated design previews.

encounterPolicy.scope: Authored underground zone encounters on levels 1 and 2 only. Skeletons and gelatinous cubes ordinarily start at level 3, while Mushroom Monster has no ambient cave pool; explicitly permit them in these named zones without changing global ambient depth rules.
encounterPolicy.population: Warrens and mushroom caverns intentionally have denser authored populations than ordinary cave dressing. Region and route ownership prevents duplication across fragments.
encounterPolicy.hiddenMechanic: Reuse the shared hidden enemy state when available on main. Dormancy must also suppress rendering and targeting, not just movement.

gemDepthPolicy.status: Runtime uses authoritative GEM_DEPOSITS tier assignments.
gemDepthPolicy.selection: Filter before weighted selection or rendering; reward matches visible gem. D1 Quartz only; D2 Quartz/Topaz. Authored nexus variants do not activate on depths 3+.

ordinaryGemScatter.bonusCombination: Use highest matching multiplier, not their product; proposal defaults give 8% ordinary and 16% bonus gem replacement per eligible rock seat.
ordinaryGemScatter.eligibility: Only non-suppressed ordinary rock-scatter seats. Never repopulate authored-zone suppression masks, protected terrain, stairs, reserved approaches, occupied cells or required through lanes.
ordinaryGemScatter.ownership: Replace an existing rock seat with a finite, stable depth-qualified gem seat; derive choice from world seed and canonical cell, not load order.

undergroundHazards.coverageDenominator: Eligible non-reserved street floor cells, measured once per canonical route and depth; combined total, not 10% for each object.
undergroundHazards.placement: Deterministic world-cell scatter in eligible street areas. Reserve dry through lanes, junctions, stairs, shrine approaches and safe bypasses first; omit blocked seats rather than filling protected cells.

inactive_poison_vent.mechanic: Inert vent: no poison emission, damage or automatic activation. Use dedicated compact vent art; ground_hole remains a separate object.

stalagmites.mechanic: Reuse charred-stakes collision, contact damage, cooldown and removal mechanics; only the appearance changes.

ground_hole.trigger: Player enters the hole cell, including accidental/backward movement. Latch one transition before showing the panel.

storyPanel.title: The ground gives way
storyPanel.body: Your footing slips at the edge of a dark opening. You tumble through the cave floor and land hard in the chamber below.

sequence: Show falling story panel and pause movement
On acknowledgement apply 25% of maximum player energy as fall damage using existing damage/depletion handling
Place player on a safe reachable landing one floor deeper
ground_hole.landing: Resolve a valid floor below before placing the hole. Use a non-hazard, non-wall landing near the corresponding world position; prevent immediate retrigger until the player leaves the destination. Omit holes when no lower floor exists.

hidden_pit.reveal: Reveal when adjacent to or on the pit, latch visibility and persist discovery. Hidden pits have no visible sprite or marker.
hidden_pit.damage: Reuse surface snare damage, trigger timing and persistence exactly; do not invent a separate damage amount.
hidden_pit.allocation: Separate optional hidden cave-trap seats; not part of the three-object 10% street dressing quota.

routeShrinePolicy.scope: All walking-path and sm_road underground variants, including every existing path theme, on depths 1 and 2.
routeShrinePolicy.ownership: One deterministic roll and at most one shrine per canonical connected route and depth; never per motif, tile fragment or intersection.
routeShrinePolicy.mechanic: Reuse existing shrine kinds, boons and daily ledger. Omit if no reachable reserved side seat exists; prevent duplicates with nexus-owned shrine seats.

nexusRuntime.geometry: Canonical source anchors and shared surface spawn gates. Layouts fit a radius-8.4-cell region; clipped tile-edge layouts fall back to ordinary caves. D2 chambers need existing floor access; Mine Tunnels only dress existing floor, including eligible projected small streets.
nexusRuntime.encounters: Finite region/depth-qualified seats; caught IDs remain defeated. Spring skeletons use shared hidden discovery at Euclidean distance <= one cell. Ambient enemy depth rules are unchanged.
nexusRuntime.budgets: Runtime BUDGETS owns counts scaled to usable ground or fitted rooms. Warrens consume the shared seeded 12–19-container shallow-floor allocation: L1 ambient barrels use its remainder; L2 has authored stores only. Shrine visits grant existing boons without a treasure gift. Existing mirrored caches retain their identity and tier.
nexusRuntime.gemCatalog: Use current GEM_DEPOSITS tiers: Quartz 1, Topaz 2, Amethyst 3. D1 Quartz; D2 Quartz/Topaz. Deposits pay the pictured item using the existing mining ledger.
nexusRuntime.limitations: Unsafe or undersized layouts decline without partial changes. Preview is a generated placement schematic, not an in-game screenshot.
